articles.title: Stocks in Asia Poised to Edge Down, Yen in Focus: Markets Wrap - Bloomberg.com
articles.description: The yen extended Monday’s rally to reach the strongest level since February, aided by rising expectations of a Bank of Japan interest-rate increase next week. Gains in South Korean chip stocks helped support Asian equities.
